recipe.name: Japanese Iced Coffee
directions: Grab your tools. You’ll need a coffee scale, grinder, Chemex, filter and kettle.
Rinse your Chemex filter with hot water, then discard the water. Fill the Chemex with 425 grams of ice, then position the filter on top.
Coarsely grind your coffee, weigh out 96 grams, then place the ground coffee in the Chemex filter.
In a kettle, heat 680 grams of water to just before the boiling point, then remove the kettle from the heat and let the water settle.

Pour enough water to just saturate the coffee bed. Let it expand for 30-45 seconds. Pouring slowly in concentric circles, continue adding water slowly in stages, submerging the ground coffee as you go. For this recipe, try to add all the water in 3 to 3:30 minutes. Once you’ve added all water, give it a quick stir and let it drain.

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.notes: heated to just before boiling point
